name: Seinfeld
description: A show about nothing, set in a New York apartment where four friends overthink everything.
setting: Upper West Side, New York City

episodes.title: The Seinfeld Chronicles
episodes.premise: Jerry discovers an old college acquaintance is coming to stay at his apartment, and he and George overanalyze every signal from a woman Jerry met on the road.

episodes.title: The Jacket
episodes.premise: Jerry buys an expensive suede jacket to impress Elaine's intimidating father, a famous author, but a rainstorm threatens to ruin it during dinner.

episodes.title: The Chinese Restaurant
episodes.premise: Jerry, George, and Elaine wait endlessly for a table at a Chinese restaurant, growing increasingly desperate as their evening plans collapse around them.

episodes.title: The Parking Garage
episodes.premise: The gang wanders a massive parking garage for hours trying to find their car, each dealing with their own escalating personal crisis.

episodes.title: The Boyfriend
episodes.premise: Jerry befriends baseball legend Keith Hernandez while George fabricates an elaborate lie to extend his unemployment benefits.

episodes.title: The Limo
episodes.premise: Jerry and George impersonate two strangers to snag a free limo ride from the airport, only to discover they're being driven to a neo-Nazi rally.

episodes.title: The Contest
episodes.premise: George's mother catches him in a compromising position, sparking a bet among the four friends over who can hold out the longest.

episodes.title: The Outing
episodes.premise: A reporter overhears Jerry and George's joke and publishes a story outing them as a couple, forcing them to repeatedly insist 'not that there's anything wrong with that.'

episodes.title: The Junior Mint
episodes.premise: Jerry can't remember his girlfriend's name while Kramer accidentally drops a Junior Mint into a patient's open body cavity during surgery.

episodes.title: The Puffy Shirt
episodes.premise: Jerry accidentally agrees to wear a ridiculous pirate-style puffy shirt on the Today Show because Kramer's low-talking girlfriend is inaudible.

episodes.title: The Dinner Party
episodes.premise: The gang splits up to buy wine and chocolate babka for a dinner party, but every simple errand spirals into confrontation and humiliation.

episodes.title: The Hamptons
episodes.premise: A weekend trip to the Hamptons goes sideways when George's girlfriend sees him after swimming in the cold pool, introducing the concept of 'shrinkage.'

episodes.title: The Opposite
episodes.premise: George decides to do the opposite of every instinct he's ever had and his life immediately improves, while Elaine's life falls apart in parallel.

episodes.title: The Label Maker
episodes.premise: Jerry suspects his dentist converted to Judaism just for the jokes, while a re-gifted label maker circulates among the group causing offense.

episodes.title: The Soup Nazi
episodes.premise: A tyrannical soup vendor terrorizes his customers with arbitrary rules — one misstep and you get 'No soup for you!' — while Elaine discovers his secret recipes.

episodes.title: The Rye
episodes.premise: George's parents take back a marble rye bread from a dinner party, forcing George and Jerry into an elaborate scheme to covertly replace it via Kramer's hansom cab.

episodes.title: The Shower Head
episodes.premise: Low-flow shower heads are installed throughout Jerry's building, leaving everyone desperate for water pressure while Elaine's failed drug test threatens her career.

episodes.title: The Bizarro Jerry
episodes.premise: Elaine befriends a group that mirrors Jerry, George, and Kramer but as kind, considerate opposites, forcing her to choose between the two worlds.

episodes.title: The Money
episodes.premise: Jerry's parents sell a Cadillac to fund his career, George becomes obsessed with his in-laws' wealth, and Kramer decides to retire from his imaginary job.

episodes.title: The Yada Yada
episodes.premise: George's girlfriend uses 'yada yada yada' to skip over crucial details in her stories, and Jerry suspects she's glossing over something terrible.

episodes.title: The Serenity Now
episodes.premise: Frank Costanza adopts a rage-management mantra of 'Serenity now!' that backfires spectacularly, while George installs a screen door to create a suburban fantasy.

episodes.title: The Cartoon
episodes.premise: Elaine submits a cartoon to The New Yorker that nobody understands, Jerry dates a woman who looks like a famous person, and Kramer gets mistaken for a serial killer.

episodes.title: The Puerto Rican Day
episodes.premise: The gang gets stuck in traffic during the Puerto Rican Day parade and each character's attempt to escape leads to increasingly absurd disasters across Manhattan.

episodes.title: The Finale
episodes.premise: Jerry, George, Elaine, and Kramer are put on trial for their years of selfish behavior as a parade of former victims testifies against them.
